name: LegalZoom
titleTag: LegalZoom alternative for free templates | docstoc
metaDescription: LegalZoom handles formation and attorney plans. docstoc is a free library of 1,000+ business and legal templates. Compare what each is built for.
headline: A free template library next to LegalZoom's legal services
sub: LegalZoom sells formation, filings and attorney plans: docstoc gives you the template, free to copy.
whatItIs: LegalZoom is an online legal services company. Its site lists business formation (LLC, corporation, DBA, nonprofit), registered agent and annual reports, trademark and copyright filings, estate planning documents, attorney plans, and tools such as legal form templates and eSignature. It is built for founders and households who want a provider to handle a filing, not only supply a form.
whereTheyAreStronger: Formation work: LLC, corporation, nonprofit and DBA filings are core products, and docstoc does none of them.
Registered agent, annual reports and business licences, so ongoing compliance can sit with one provider.
Trademark, copyright and provisional patent services.
Attorney access through business and personal plans, which a template library cannot replace.
whereDocstocFits: You only need a document, such as an NDA, a lease or a policy, and want to copy and edit it without paying for a service.
You want 1,000+ templates in business, legal, real estate, finance and HR that you can open without a membership.
You want a tamper-evident certificate for the final file: the SHA-256 hash is computed in your browser and the file is never uploaded.
You also chase late invoices: docstoc drafts the reminder email and you send it yourself.

comparison.competitor: Legal services: formation, filings, attorney plans, with legal form templates among its tools.
comparison.docstoc: Template library plus invoice chase drafts, document certificates and SSL automation.

comparison.competitor: Offered, as listed on its site.
comparison.docstoc: Not offered.

comparison.competitor: Business and personal attorney plans.
comparison.docstoc: None. Templates are information, not legal advice.

comparison.competitor: Legal form templates are listed as a tool; this page does not state whether they need a paid plan.
comparison.docstoc: 1,000+ free templates, editable online, PDF download with a docstoc.io footer.

comparison.competitor: The homepage describes flat-rate fees but states no amounts; check current prices at checkout.
comparison.docstoc: Templates free. Pro is $14.99 per month and Business $39.99 per month, listed on the docstoc pricing page.

whenToChoose.competitor: Choose LegalZoom if you are forming a company, need a registered agent, want a trademark filed or want an attorney plan. A provider handling the filing is the point, and a template library does not do that work.
whenToChoose.docstoc: Choose docstoc if your company already exists and you need the next agreement or policy. Copy the template, edit it, certify the finished file, and ask a lawyer when the matter carries real risk.

faq.q: Is docstoc a replacement for LegalZoom?
faq.a: No, it covers a smaller job. docstoc is a template library, so formation, filings, registered agent and attorney plans stay with a provider like LegalZoom.

faq.q: Do I need an account to copy a docstoc template?
faq.a: The library is described as free and editable, and docstoc's own summary describes it as a no signup library. Certificates and paid features need an account.
They are general starting points, not legal advice. Check them against your jurisdiction and have a lawyer review anything important.

gaps: LegalZoom template pricing and access terms could not be confirmed (pricing page returned 410).
Whether the docstoc library needs no signup: llms-full.txt says so, but the template page itself did not confirm it.

name: PandaDoc
titleTag: PandaDoc alternative for free templates | docstoc

whatItIs: PandaDoc is a document creation and e-signature platform. Its plans cover a drag-and-drop editor, templates, real-time tracking, approval workflows, custom quotes and sales agreements, and CRM integrations on higher tiers. Plans are priced per seat, from a Free plan to Starter, Business and a custom Enterprise tier. It is built for teams that send proposals, quotes and agreements and want to track them to signature.
whereTheyAreStronger: E-signature and tracking: even the Free plan includes e-sign, real-time tracking and notifications.
Sales workflows: Business lists custom quotes, approval workflows, deal rooms, a content library and custom branding.
Integrations: CRM integrations, web forms and bulk send are listed as add-ons, and an API is available.
Enterprise options include single sign-on and data residency in the US or EU.
whereDocstocFits: You need the legal or business document itself, such as a contractor agreement or a lease, while PandaDoc lists up to 5 templates on the Free and Starter plans.
You want to read and copy templates without paying per seat.
You want a hash certificate for the final file with a public verify page.
You want invoice reminder drafts in the same account; you send the email yourself.

comparison.docstoc: Template library, certificates, chase drafts, SSL automation.

comparison.docstoc: Library free; 5 AI chase drafts per month without signup.

whenToChoose.docstoc: Choose docstoc if you need a starting document, a proof of the final file, or invoice reminders. Use it before PandaDoc or next to it, and keep signing wherever you already sign.
